mechanism: A violent upward pulse (14.70 to 26.70 in eight sessions) broke the field at its own crest: 2026-08-06 took three channel deaths with a dead-channel URF=0.000 reading and S_UF sagging to 0.726 - the damage arrived inside the thrust, not at lows. Since the crest, displacement has run negative at nearly every reading (D-=5 on most sessions, D=-1 through the final three days) while price bleeds 26.70 to 20.13 and the surviving lattice slowly re-knits (URF back to 0.43, F_n ~2.35, S_UF stable ~0.82); the stored energy of the spike is being distributed downward. The arrow of the field is still down and the pulse is not yet fully dissipated.
